title: Steamers Across the Channel
text: Opened in 1869, Clevedon Pier served both holidaymakers and Bristol Channel paddle steamers. Excursion vessels connected Clevedon with Cardiff, Penarth, Weston-super-Mare and Ilfracombe, turning the pier into a busy maritime gateway.

title: The Day the Pier Fell
text: During a load test on 16 October 1970 the first six spans passed, then the seventh failed and brought down the eighth; the pier head and pavilion stayed standing. A long campaign saved the pier: it was dismantled in 1985, rebuilt, and its spans reopened on 27 May 1989, with the pier head following in 1998.
